name: strix-structured-cloud-failure-provenance
instr:
Give every managed-cloud failure one safe, structured provenance record across command preparation, request execution, source handling, and presentation. Callers should be able to determine what happened remotely, what cleanup occurred, and how to recover without exposing credentials or changing established behavior.

The immutable failure types and `classify_response_failure` are public from `strix.interface.cloud.failure`, and every cloud failure preserves monotonically advancing phase, certainty, retryability, cleanup disposition, correlation, upload recovery identity, and occurrence-ordered causes. Outcome classification is authoritative for both lifecycle effects and output, distinguishing not sent, rejected, accepted, and unknown mutations without contradicting actual upload cleanup. Correlation survives retries and cleanup unchanged but never derives from authorization or secret material. `sanitize_failure_value(value)` from `strix.interface.cloud.redaction` deterministically bounds and sanitizes arbitrary nested, cyclic, binary, oversized, or secret-bearing values into serializable, terminal-safe data. Secondary lifecycle, compensation, payment, and cleanup failures preserve the primary cause and interruption semantics. `failure_to_dict(failure)`, `format_failure(failure)`, and `emit_failure` from `strix.interface.cloud.diagnostics` present equivalent safe facts, with JSON using the exact `diagnostic` field and human output showing each recovery instruction at most on
